name: Unusual payments to unfamiliar beneficiaries -> improper payment risk
rationale: Payments to unfamiliar beneficiaries bypass the implicit control of a known supplier relationship. The rule directs full-population beneficiary analysis, vouching of unusual payments to supporting documents, and tracing of new beneficiaries to verification evidence.
source_reference: Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
